name: Vestibowl
summary:
Step into the world of immersive virtual bowling with Vestibowl — a fun and accessible VR bowling experience built exclusively for Meta Quest.

Designed for both casual players and VR enthusiasts, Vestibowl combines intuitive gameplay, satisfying physics-based bowling mechanics, and immersive virtual environments to create a relaxing and entertaining experience in virtual reality.
